answers.core: These two enhancements are small modifications to split_container.cpp, but greatly improve it's utility.
answers.workaround: Extremely difficult to implement in script - all of the visual split bar elements have to be drawn over a split container with dragging disabled, and the script has to set the offset when the overlaid control is dragged.

title: Improve SplitContainer grab area by adding margin properties and exposing the Control to scripting
